headline: Khaitan & Co advises Capital Numbers on the acquisition of Epitome Cloud Inc.
sum: Capital Numbers Infotech Limited has acquired 100% ownership in New Jersey-based Epitome Cloud Inc., and has indirectly acquired its Indian subsidiary, Epitomecloud Technology Private Limited. Khaitan & Co advised Capital Numbers on this…
detail: Capital Numbers Infotech Limited has acquired 100% ownership in New Jersey-based Epitome Cloud Inc., and has indirectly acquired its Indian subsidiary, Epitomecloud Technology Private Limited. Khaitan & Co advised Capital Numbers on this acquisition. The transaction team consisted of Prithwijit Gangopadhyay (Partner), Shounak Mitra (Partner), Vibhav Seth (Principal Associate) Karishma Sethia (Senior Associate), Keshav Tibarewalla (Senior Associate), Associates Ishika Sinha and Lavanya Agarwal. The deal team was assisted by the following: Employment aspects: Abhinav Rastogi (Partner) and Ajeta Anand (Senior Associate) Intellectual property aspects: Sourav Dan (Counsel).
